reviews.author: Anton Rudov
reviews.text:
Had my Triumph Speedmaster in for a regular service and had a really good experience. Great communication throughout, everything was explained clearly, and they kept me updated on the work. They even gave me a discount and, most importantly, treated the bike like it was their own

Also really appreciated the little things — friendly guys, a great atmosphere, and they even offered me a coffee while I was there. The bike came back in perfect shape. Definitely coming back. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Vlad Gvozdyk
reviews.text:
Thanks, guys! I stopped by today to have my Yamaha XSR700 serviced, and everything was great. We also chatted about a future Royal Enfield custom project, had a coffee and just enjoyed talking bikes.

Iron Custom Motors is a fantastic multi-brand workshop where you can not only get your bike properly looked after, but also bring your ideas to life and build something truly unique.

Great people, great atmosphere and quality work. Definitely my new go-to workshop. Highly recommended — five stars! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.author: Aleksandr F
reviews.text:
Great service — these guys really take their work seriously!
I had my rear tire repaired here after a puncture, and my front sprocket replaced.
Done quickly and done right!

reviews.author: Dream Carua
reviews.text:
Without a doubt, the best motorcycle workshop I’ve visited in Portugal, and probably one of the best anywhere.

Iron Custom Motors is much more than a repair shop—it’s a true motorcycle museum and a place where you simply want to spend time. The atmosphere is incredible, with stunning custom bikes, racing history, and an obvious passion for motorcycles in every detail.

The service is absolutely outstanding. The team genuinely cares about every customer and every motorcycle, no matter how big or small the job is. Their attention to detail, technical knowledge, honesty, and professionalism are on another level. They explain everything clearly, keep you informed, and never cut corners.

I was also pleasantly surprised by the pricing. For this level of expertise and customer care, the prices are more than fair and represent exceptional value.

If you’re anywhere near Cascais or Lisbon and need motorcycle service, repairs, upgrades, or simply love motorcycles, this is the place to visit. Even if your bike doesn’t need anything, stop by for a coffee and enjoy the showroom—it’s worth the trip by itself.

Highly recommended. Five stars aren’t enough! 🏍️👏

reviews.author: Eugene Tkachevsky
reviews.text:
If you been hunting for a workshop you can actually trust, stop here

My friends and I tried 5 different shops around Lisbon looking for the right one, and Iron Custom Motors — and Yaroslav in particular — is the best I've come across, by a long 3 years way

I brought in a Dyna FXDL that had been through other hands workshop recently. Yaroslav went over the whole bike properly: a full front fork cartrigies replacement and adjastment, new Brembo sintered pads front and rear, a complete brake system bleed with fresh DOT 5.1, new wheel hub bearings, and — the big one for me — the steering column bearings and stem nut sorted out after the previous shops had left the front end worn and unsafe. He also serviced the K&N filter and handled a long list of smaller jobs that had been done badly or ignored elsewhere: cleaning out the breathers, fixing the headlight, cleaning and greasing the axles, servicing the calipers, fitting a proper exhaust clamp. On top of the invoice work, he helped me dial in my suspension setup, which made a real (siginificant) difference to how the bike rides

What sets him apart is the attention to detail. I more or less know my way around motorcycles and engines, so I can tell when someone actually understands what they're doing — and Yaroslav does. He photographs and films every stage of the work, so you see exactly what's going on with your bike. He cleans every bolt, greases every axle, and genuinely cares about getting it right. One small example that stuck with me: the bike came in with no wheel balancing at all, and he managed to get it down to an incredible 30 grams just by fine-tuning rubber and belt pulley. He recommends fair, sensible parts to order rather than padding the bill, and he adapts to what you actually want — from upgrade parts down to the exact type of brake pad.

Long story short: Yaroslav treats the machine like it matters. If you want honest, supers skilled work and a shop that loves the bikes it works on, this is the place

Thank you, Yaroslav🤝🏻
